---

```{r}
library(learnr2)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_wide <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

ggplot(age_ca_wide, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    data = slice_max(age_ca_wide, population, n = 5),
    aes(label = NAME),
    nudge_y = 0.6,
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age and Population by California County",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    total_adults = first(summary_est),
    bachelor_or_higher = sum(
      estimate[variable %in% c(
        "B15003_022",
        "B15003_023",
        "B15003_024",
        "B15003_025"
      )],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(percent_bachelor_or_higher = 100 * bachelor_or_higher / total_adults) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelor_or_higher),
    y = percent_bachelor_or_higher
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Population with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Median income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
```
